criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Slides 1, 5 and 8 pass the bold test at 432 px. Slide 2 is a mid-grey card with a speck for the parcel, slide 7 reads as a bar chart, slide 3's bays sit over the louvres, slide 4's transformer is a grey box, slide 9 lights many panes.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One staged last-light world, one key, the accent kept for planned. The reliefs step out of the spatial world and the fence motif is too faint.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every figure traces and attribution is kept. The caption's first line states c20 as fact, and every deal fact rests on Soluna's releases with no 8-K fetched.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: County, town, parties, plan, condition and close all land. The deciding body, a date and what an abatement means for taxpayers are missing.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The turn sits at 5 and 6 pays it off. The cover is jargon, frame 2 doesn't pay at once, slide 7 restates acreage.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register, attribution heavy, careful rather than Texan.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New geography and subject, the same staged last-light register and several familiar devices.

one_sentence_fix: Name the Commissioners Court as the body that votes the abatement, what it gives up and when it next meets, from a primary source.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat mid-grey noise square, the parcel a speck.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crop to the ten miles around Silverton, cut the escarpment into the height field under a grazing key.
A grazing key so each furrow casts, darker troughs, a scale figure.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Bays laid over the louvres, empty grass below.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Glow through the kit louvres, camera lower and in.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: An anonymous grey box at feed size.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pull back so the gantry, road and pasture fence share the frame.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The BRISCOE WIND leader lands on a bare pole.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Retarget it to a turbine, let the pasture beyond the pool fall to black.
